setup: CREATE TABLE c2_string_agg AS SELECT i, i%8192 AS many_group, i%64 AS few_group, CASE WHEN i%17=16 THEN NULL WHEN i%7=0 THEN repeat('x', 96) ELSE 'v' || (i%31)::VARCHAR END AS value, i%97 AS order_key FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: string_agg_few_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT string_agg(value, '|') FROM c2_string_agg GROUP BY few_group

workloads.name: string_agg_many_groups
workloads.sql: SELECT string_agg(value, '|') FROM c2_string_agg GROUP BY many_group

workloads.name: string_agg_ordered_distinct
workloads.sql: SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT value, '|' ORDER BY value) FROM c2_string_agg

workloads.name: string_agg_sum_list_consumers
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i), list_extract(list(value ORDER BY order_key), 1), string_agg(value, '|') FROM c2_string_agg GROUP BY few_group
